notes: TBox contraction paired with physics-replace-0019: removes the original rule of that revision ("every mechanical wave needs a material medium to travel through and cannot travel through a vacuum"). Stored facts only; no indeterminate queries. Definitional removal (this is what separates mechanical from electromagnetic waves); slice results as definitional. The three derived queries name made-up kinds of mechanical wave (they ask whether each can cross a vacuum or empty space) (inheritance, 2 hops); after the removal nothing else the model holds answers them, so the target is "does not know". Propositional targets follow strong Kleene logic and all become unknown. Near and far unrelated queries are kept from the revision (contraction is exempt from Rule 7). The negation is worded "some mechanical wave can travel through a vacuum", the logical negation of the universal.
